expr: (() => { const R=[...document.querySelectorAll('#sim-root input[type=range]')]; const S=window.simState; return R.length===3 && R[0].value==='0' && R[1].value==='2' && R[2].value==='0' && document.querySelector('#sim-root select').value==='1' && S.v0===0 && S.a===2 && S.t===0 && S.x===0 && S.v===0 && S.running===false ? 1 : 0 })()

three sliders: v0 −6…6 m/s step 1, a −3…3 m/s² step 0,5, t 0…6 s step 0,5

expr: (() => { const o=[...document.querySelector('#sim-root select').options].map(x=>x.textContent+':'+x.value).join(','); return o==='hidas:0.5,normaali:1,nopea:2' && document.querySelectorAll('#sim-root select').length===1 ? 1 : 0 })()
note: one select, the speed: hidas 0.5, normaali 1, nopea 2

expr: (() => { const b=[...document.querySelectorAll('#sim-root button')].map(x=>x.textContent); const k=[...document.getElementById('sim-root').children].map(e=>e.classList.contains('sim-canvas')||e.tagName==='CANVAS'?'canvas':e.className); return b.length===2 && b[0]==='Käynnistä' && b[1]==='Alusta' && k.indexOf('canvas')<k.indexOf('controls') && k.indexOf('controls')<k.indexOf('readout') ? 1 : 0 })()
note: main button Käynnistä first, then Alusta; DOM order canvas, controls, readout

expr: (() => { const L=[...document.querySelectorAll('#sim-root label')]; const s=L.map(x=>simText(x)); return L.length===4 && /^Alkunopeus \$v_0 = 0\\,\\text\{m\/s\}\$/.test(s[0]) && /^Kiihtyvyys \$a = 2\{,\}0\\,\\text\{m\/s\}\^2\$/.test(s[1]) && /^Hetki \$t = 0\{,\}0\\,\\text\{s\}\$/.test(s[2]) && s[3].startsWith('Nopeus (toisto)') ? 1 : 0 })()
note: four labelled controls with LaTeX values: Alkunopeus v0, Kiihtyvyys a, Hetki t, Nopeus (toisto)

expr: (() => { const n=document.querySelectorAll('#sim-root p.note'); return !document.querySelector('#sim-root details') && n.length===1 && n[0].textContent.trim().split(/\s+/).length<=15 ? 1 : 0 })()
note: no Lisätietoja box; one legend line of at most 15 words

expr: (() => { const P=window.simAdapter && window.simAdapter.params; return P && Object.keys(P).sort().join(',')==='a,t,v0' && P.t.unit==='s' && P.v0.unit==='m/s' ? 1 : 0 })()
note: adapter declares v0 (m/s), a (m/s²) and t (s)

expr: (() => { const c=document.querySelector('#sim-root canvas'); return c.width===600 && c.height===400 ? 1 : 0; })()
